sources.name: Jàngileen — dictionnaire wolof
sources.action: Maintain the sourced snapshot with the importer workflow. Audit variants, part of speech, and examples; do not describe this as the complete dictionary until the remaining source coverage is reconciled.
sources.importNotes: The automated snapshot currently contains 750 French–Wolof records with per-entry source URLs. Jàngileen reports 911 Wolof words; this count is not directly comparable to the number of extracted French headword/sense records. Source examples are preserved without assigning a language because the site's example labels are inconsistent and need review.
